description: Find drugs and clinical candidates with a curated mechanism for a target, a recorded indication for a disease, or both in the same molecule family. Supply a target from chembl_search_targets, a disease term or ontology ID, or both. Each result represents a source record or matching pair, so a family may appear several times. Use parent_molecule_chembl_id with chembl_get_drug_info for warnings, cited evidence and withdrawal status.

cursor.description: Continuation from nextCursor. Resend the same target, indication and phase floor.

indication.description: Case-insensitive substring of a MeSH heading or EFO term, or an exact disease identifier such as D015464 or EFO:0000339.

limit.description: Maximum evidence rows this page, up to 100.

max_phase_min.description: Minimum phase for each selected record. Phase 4 includes drugs withdrawn after approval.

target_chembl_id.description: Target with a recorded drug mechanism, e.g. CHEMBL1862.

name: chembl_search_drugs

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `missing_filter`: Neither target nor indication was supplied. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is invalid or belongs to a different query. `rate_limited`: ChEMBL rate-limits the upstream request. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

matches.description: Matching source records or pairs. An empty page with a cursor can be continued.

items.description: One source record, or a pair of source records linked by family parent.

efo_id.description: Disease ontology ID recorded in the EFO field.

max_phase_for_ind.description: Highest phase for this form and indication.

molecule_chembl_id.description: Form on which ChEMBL filed this source record.

molecule_max_phase.description: Highest clinical phase recorded for this form across indications.

pref_name.description: Preferred name of this form, when available.

indication.description: Matching indication record when searching by disease.

max_phase.description: Clinical phase on this mechanism record.

molecule_chembl_id.description: Form on which ChEMBL filed this source record.

molecule_max_phase.description: Highest clinical phase recorded for this form across indications.

pref_name.description: Preferred name of this form, when available.

mechanism.description: Matching mechanism record when searching by target.

nextCursor.description: Continuation for the next page. Absent at the end.

notice.description: Guidance for an empty page or a limit served at the cap.

totalCount.description: Exact number of matching evidence rows when available. Null when unknown.

title: chembl-search-drugs
